stdout:
Get video ratings. Use this tool to get video ratings by IDs.

Usage:
  yutu video getRating [flags]

Examples:
# Get rating of a video
yutu video getRating --ids dQw4w9WgXcQ
# Get ratings of multiple videos in JSON format
yutu video getRating --ids dQw4w9WgXcQ,abc123 --output json

Flags:
  -h, --help                            help for getRating
  -i, --ids strings                     IDs of the videos to get the rating for
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string   ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -o, --output string                   json|yaml|table (default "table")
